integrity.instruction: Calculate SHA-256 locally and compare it exactly with the value published in the same GitHub Release.

binarySigning.note: The public site does not claim that the current community binaries are Authenticode-signed. Verify the GitHub Release source and SHA-256 before execution.

sbom.note: CycloneDX SBOM and dependency evidence are published when produced by the release workflow; the selected GitHub Release asset list is authoritative.
